Package com.bdtripp.hauntedhouse.model

Class Room

java.lang.Object
com.bdtripp.hauntedhouse.model.Room
public class Room extends Object
Represents a room in the Haunted House game. It is connected to other rooms via exits. The exits are labelled north, south, east, and west. For each direction, the room stores a reference to the neighboring room, or null if there is no exit in that direction.
Author:
Michael Kölling, David J. Barnes, and Brian Tripp
